text: I don't understand some drivers in my town. How is it that a small city can have gridlock traffic on a 3-lane, both ways, interstate. When the capital of the state which has at least triple the population only has that issue during peak rush or during sports events. My town however can have it be gridlock from 11-2pm and then again 3-7pm every day. The part that is insane to me, is that going one direction is worse than the other. Also, sometimes it's only the problematic side that's in gridlock, while the other is free flowing all day.
